title: Failing grades soar with AI usage, dwindling math skills in Berkeley CS classes
summary: UC Berkeley student newspaper reports that failing grades are increasing significantly in computer science courses, with professors observing a correlation between widespread AI tool usage and students' deteriorating fundamental math and programming skills.
problem_solved: Documenting the unintended consequences of AI adoption in higher education on student learning outcomes.
why_valuable: Highlights a critical challenge facing academia: balancing AI tool integration with maintaining core competency development.
